settings_profile_hint: Photo, banner, name, bio, links and pinned mods.
settings_security_hint: Where you are signed in, and signing out other devices.
settings_notifications_hint: Which signals you get in the app and by email.
settings_preferences_hint: Language, theme, motion, shortcuts and mature content.
settings_privacy_hint: What others see on your profile and your download history.
settings_creator_hint: Creator status, support links, default license and reply templates.
settings_data_hint: Export everything we have about you, or delete your account.
settings_photos_text: Your avatar and the banner at the top of your profile. Changes are saved as soon as the upload finishes.
settings_avatar_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF up to {max, number} MB. You can crop it before it is saved.
settings_banner_terrain_hint: A map drawn just for you. Reroll it until you like the shape of your island.
settings_banner_reroll_hint: New terrain previewed — choose «Use this terrain» to keep it.
settings_banner_custom_hint: You are using your own image. Reroll to go back to a generated terrain.
settings_image_type: That file type isn’t supported. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF.
settings_image_size: That image is too large. The limit is {max, number} MB.
settings_image_rejected: The image was rejected. Try a different one.
settings_image_processing: The image is taking too long to process. Try again in a moment.
settings_crop_help: Drag the image or use the arrow keys to move it; use the slider or + and − to zoom.
settings_crop_failed: This image couldn’t be read. Try another file.
settings_about_text: How you appear on your profile, your mods and your comments.
settings_display_name_hint: Any language and characters, 2–32 long. You can change it any time.
settings_display_name_length: Use between {min, number} and {max, number} characters.
settings_handle_hint: Your profile address. Handles can’t be changed yet.
settings_bio_too_long: Keep your bio under {max, number} characters.
settings_chars_left: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
settings_links_text: Up to {max, number} links on your profile: your site, channels and where people can support you.
settings_link_invalid: Enter a full web address starting with https://
settings_pinned_text: Choose up to {max, number} of your mods to show first on your profile, in this order.
settings_pinned_empty: Once one of your mods is published you can pin it here.
settings_pinned_hidden: Some pinned mods aren’t public right now; they stay pinned and show again when they are.
settings_email_text: Used to sign in and for the emails you choose to get. To change it, confirm the new address from your inbox; we’ll let the old one know.
settings_email_taken: That address can’t be used. Try another one.
settings_email_sent_text: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Your address changes once you open it.
settings_verify_text: Until you do, you can browse and download but not comment, review or publish.
settings_verify_resent: We sent a new link to {email}
settings_verify_already: Your email address is already verified
settings_password_text: At least {min, number} characters. A long phrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
settings_password_revoke_hint: Recommended if you think someone else knows your password.
settings_password_same: Choose a password different from the current one.
settings_password_mismatch: The two new passwords don’t match.
settings_password_rejected: This password appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
settings_password_changed_revoked: Password changed and other devices signed out
settings_sessions_text: Every browser and device with an active session. Sign out any you don’t recognise.
settings_sessions_count: {count, plural, one {# active session} other {# active sessions}}
settings_sessions_confirm_text: {device} will need to sign in again.
settings_sessions_confirm_current_text: You’ll go to the sign-in page.
settings_sessions_confirm_others_text: {count, plural, one {# other session will end.} other {# other sessions will end.}} This browser stays signed in.
settings_security_tip_password: Use a password you don’t use anywhere else.
settings_security_tip_sessions: Sign out of shared or public computers when you’re done.
settings_security_tip_email: We never ask for your password by email or on Discord.
settings_notif_matrix_text: For each kind of signal, choose whether it shows in the app and how often it’s emailed. Digests bundle everything into one email.
settings_notif_version_hint: A mod in your backpack released an update.
settings_notif_creator_hint: A creator you follow published something new.
settings_notif_patch_hint: A new game build is likely to break mods (sent to creators).
settings_notif_comment_hint: Bundled: several comments arrive as one signal.
settings_notif_review_hint: Someone rated one of your mods.
settings_notif_broken_hint: Field reports say a mod of yours broke on the current build.
settings_notif_status_hint: A mod of yours was approved, rejected, needs changes or was archived.
settings_notif_weekly_hint: Mondays: downloads, followers and reviews of your mods.
settings_notif_ack_hint: An author saw or fixed a problem you reported.
settings_notif_compat_prompt_hint: A new game build is out and you have downloads to report on.
settings_notif_review_update_hint: A mod you reviewed released a new major version.
settings_notif_kit_added_hint: Someone added a mod of yours to a public kit.
settings_notif_report_hint: The Rangers reviewed something you reported.
settings_notif_milestone_hint: A mod of yours passed a download milestone.
settings_notif_award_hint: A mod of yours became Mod of the Week or a Staff pick.
settings_notif_announcement_hint: News from the SOTF Mods team.
settings_notif_removal_note: If a mod of yours is removed you are always told by email.
settings_language_text: The language of the console and of the emails we send you.
settings_appearance_text: How SOTF Mods looks on this and your other devices.
settings_motion_system_hint: Follows the reduced-motion setting of your system.
settings_shortcuts_hint: Single-key shortcuts in the console. Turn them off if they get in the way of your assistive technology.
settings_compat_prompts_hint: Your answers tell other survivors which mods run on the current build.
settings_nsfw_text: Mods marked as NSFW are hidden from lists, search and feeds, and blurred everywhere except their own page. Turn this on to see them.
settings_nsfw_confirm_text: NSFW mods can contain nudity or graphic content. You can hide them again at any time.
settings_nsfw_adult: I am 18 or older (or the age of majority where I live)
settings_visibility_text: Turn off anything you’d rather keep to yourself.
settings_show_activity_hint: The 12-month heatmap and your recent activity.
settings_show_rank: Show my survivor rank and XP
settings_show_rank_hint: Your rank stamp next to your name.
settings_show_leaderboards_hint: Top creators and top survivors lists.
settings_show_kits_hint: The Kits tab of your profile (private kits are never shown).
settings_history_text: When it’s on, the downloads you make while signed in are listed in «My downloads» so we can tell you about updates.
settings_privacy_data_text: You can export everything we store about you, or delete your account.
settings_creator_verified_text: Your mods carry the verified mark and you can upload larger files.
settings_creator_not_verified_text: The Rangers verify creators with a track record of safe, maintained mods. Keep publishing — there’s nothing to apply for.
settings_support_text: Ko-fi and Patreon links from your profile appear on your profile and next to your mods’ download button.
settings_support_empty: You haven’t added a Ko-fi or Patreon link yet.
settings_defaults_text: Pre-fill new mods and reply faster to common questions.
settings_defaults_local_note: These defaults are saved in this browser only.
settings_default_license_hint: Pre-selected when you publish a new mod; you can still change it per mod.
settings_templates_text: Up to {max, number} ready-made answers (installation steps, known conflicts…) to copy into comments and review replies.
settings_template_name_error: Give it a name (up to {max, number} characters).
settings_template_text_error: Write the text (up to {max, number} characters).
settings_creator_policy: Everything you publish follows the content policy.
settings_export_text: A ZIP of JSON files with your account, profile, mods, comments, reviews, kits, follows and settings.
settings_export_rate_limited: You requested an export recently — try again later
settings_export_status_failed: The export failed. Please try again.
settings_export_email_note: We also email you the download link. It works for 24 hours.
settings_delete_text: This permanently removes your personal data after a 14-day grace period.
settings_delete_point_grace: You have 14 days to change your mind; signing in and cancelling here stops it.
settings_delete_point_content: Your comments and reviews stay, signed as «Deleted survivor».
settings_delete_point_mods: Your mods are archived, or stay published without your name — you choose.
settings_delete_point_export: Export your data first if you want a copy.
settings_delete_dialog_text: Your account is deleted in 14 days. Until then you can cancel from this page.
settings_delete_mode_archive_hint: They are hidden from lists and search and no longer credited to you.
settings_delete_mode_keep_hint: Players keep finding them, without your name attached.
settings_delete_already: A deletion is already scheduled for your account.
settings_delete_scheduled_toast: Your account will be deleted on {date}
settings_delete_scheduled_title: Your account will be deleted on {date}
settings_delete_scheduled_text: Changed your mind? Cancel now and everything stays as it is.
settings_featured_badges_text: Choose up to {max} earned badges for the header of your profile.
settings_featured_badges_empty: Earn badges on the island to feature them here.
settings_2fa_text: Use an authenticator app so a stolen password is not enough to sign in.
settings_2fa_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand.
settings_2fa_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
settings_2fa_code_or_recovery: Code from your app or a recovery code
settings_2fa_codes_text: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator app. They are shown only now.
settings_2fa_staff_text: Moderator and admin accounts can do a lot. Turn on two-step verification or add a passkey.
settings_passkeys_text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device lock instead of a password. A passkey can also be your second step.
settings_passkeys_remove_text: Enter your password to remove {name}. You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
settings_passkeys_cancelled: The passkey was not created (cancelled or not available on this device).
settings_passkeys_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
settings_notif_kit_updated_hint: A kit you follow gets new mods or changes.
settings_notif_kit_comment_hint: Someone comments on a kit you curate.
settings_notif_kit_reply_hint: Someone replies to your comment on a kit.
settings_notif_coauthor_hint: Someone invites you to co-author one of their mods.
settings_notif_request_comment_hint: Someone commented on a request you made or adopted.
settings_notif_request_adopted_hint: A creator started working on your request.
settings_notif_request_fulfilled_hint: A mod you requested or voted for was published.
